files.README.md:
# swift-sql-postgresql-conversions-dtos

Data access layer generated by [DB2CRUD](https://github.com/RaulEstevezA/DB2CRUD) for a database that already exists: plain entities, repositories with their own SQL through SQLKit 3.36.0 and services, in Swift with async/await. It does not create or migrate the database, and it depends on no web framework.

## Settings

- Database: postgresql.
- Entities: written for the tables the input had no type for.
- Services: take and return DTOs; updates take a Patch per field: .absent, or set to a value that may be nil.
- Transactions: one transaction per service operation, committed when it ends.
- Lists: lists return pages by offset and limit.

## Layout

```text
Sources/SwiftSqlPostgresqlConversionsDtos/AppDatabase.swift   the connection of DATABASE_URL
Sources/SwiftSqlPostgresqlConversionsDtos/UnitOfWork.swift    the repositories of every table, and the transaction of each operation
Sources/SwiftSqlPostgresqlConversionsDtos/Errors.swift        DomainError: notFound, conflict, validationFailed; no HTTP codes
Sources/SwiftSqlPostgresqlConversionsDtos/Entities/          one entity per table
Sources/SwiftSqlPostgresqlConversionsDtos/Repositories/      the repositories of each table
Sources/SwiftSqlPostgresqlConversionsDtos/Services/          one service per table
Tests/SwiftSqlPostgresqlConversionsDtosTests/            repositories against a database, services on the in-memory repositories
crud-contract.json                     what was written, for CRUD2Controller
```

## Running the tests

```bash
TEST_DATABASE_URL="postgres://app:app@localhost:5432/app" swift test   # a real, disposable database: it is emptied
```

Look for `TODO` in the code: each one marks a decision the input did not settle.

import Foundation

/// Product, as the application has it.
public struct Product: Sendable, Equatable {
    public var id: Int
    public var name: String
    public var price: Decimal
    public var status: ProductStatus
    public var categoryName: String
    public var tagIds: [Int]

    public init(id: Int, name: String, price: Decimal, status: ProductStatus, categoryName: String, tagIds: [Int]) {
        self.id = id
        self.name = name
        self.price = price
        self.status = status
        self.categoryName = categoryName
        self.tagIds = tagIds
    }
}
